activities.title: Welcome Back: What Works Well?
activities.summary: Students review one feedback-ready design image and answer five visible-clue questions about what works well before the week moves into critique language.

en.title: Welcome Back: What Works Well?
en.summary: Look at one design image and choose the best answer for each quick question.
en.instructions: Look at the design image first. Choose the best answer for each short question about what works well in the look.
success_criteria: I can notice one clear strength in the design.
I can use visible clues to choose my answer.
I can prepare for simple feedback this week.

pt.title: Bem-vindo de volta: o que funciona bem?
pt.summary: Observe uma imagem de design e escolha a melhor resposta para cada pergunta rapida.
pt.instructions: Observe primeiro a imagem do design. Escolha a melhor resposta para cada pergunta curta sobre o que funciona bem no look.
success_criteria: Eu consigo perceber um ponto forte claro no design.
Eu consigo usar pistas visiveis para escolher minha resposta.
Eu consigo me preparar para um feedback simples nesta semana.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep every answer tied to visible clues on the opener image. Do not ask students for open opinion here.

input.prompt_en: Choose the best review answer for each question about the design.
input.prompt_pt: Escolha a melhor resposta de revisao para cada pergunta sobre o design.

items.label_en: What works well first in this design?

activities.title: Feedback Phrase Bank

activities.title: Positive, Reason, Suggestion, or Revision Plan?

en.title: Positive, Reason, Suggestion, or Revision Plan?

materials: Week 13 reusable feedback gallery image A to image D

input.prompt_en: Read the four short feedback comments below, then choose the correct image key or detail answer.
input.prompt_pt: Leia abaixo os quatro comentarios curtos de feedback e depois escolha a chave correta da imagem ou a resposta correta de detalhe.
input.reference_text_en:
Comment 1: I like the soft color palette because it feels calm. The flowy fabric works well with the dress. You could add one small detail near the neckline.

Comment 2: I like the jacket because it is modern and practical. The zipper and pockets work well. Maybe you could add more contrast to the color palette.

Comment 3: The strongest part is the bright silhouette. The wide pants create an energetic mood. You could clarify the caption and make the main idea clearer.

Comment 4: I like the textured detail because it looks balanced and elegant. The overall look is clear. Maybe you could simplify one extra decoration.
